response: You can cancel an order from Orders > Cancel within 60 minutes of purchase. After that the order has entered fulfilment, so please request a return once it arrives.
Order changes are possible while the status is still Processing: open Orders, select the order and choose Edit. Once it ships, the only option is a return and re-order.
You can change the shipping address until the order ships, from Orders > Edit. After dispatch the carrier may still allow a redirect via your tracking link.
Cancelling within the 60-minute window is free. After fulfilment begins, return shipping may be deducted from the refund.
Your invoices are listed under Account > Billing, including invoice {{Invoice Number}} for each completed order.
We accept major credit and debit cards, PayPal and bank transfer. Available methods are shown at checkout and vary by country.
Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition. Refunds go to the original payment method once the return is received.
I am sorry about this. Please file the details under Help > Complaints and a specialist will review and respond within two business days.
You can reach support by email, live chat, or phone on {{Customer Support Phone Number}}. Live chat is usually fastest.
I can hand you to a human agent now. Live chat is available during business hours; out of hours we reply by email within one working day.
Choose Sign Up and register with your email address. You will receive a verification link to activate the account.
Account deletion is under Account > Privacy > Delete Account. This is permanent and removes your order history, so download any invoices first.
Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days and express arrives the next business day. Options and costs are shown at checkout for your address.
Most orders arrive within 3-5 business days of dispatch. Your confirmation email lists the estimated delivery date for your address.
Update your name, email, password and preferences under Account > Profile. Changing your email requires confirming the new address.
Download any invoice as a PDF from Account > Billing. Invoices are also attached to the order confirmation email.
Start a return from Orders > Return. Once we receive the item, the refund is issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Manage email preferences under Account > Communications. Every newsletter also carries a one-click unsubscribe link.
Declined payments are usually an issuer block or a billing address mismatch. Confirm the details, try another method, or contact your bank.
Add items to your basket and choose Checkout. You can pay as a guest, but an account lets you track the order and re-order faster.
Use Forgot Password on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes and sometimes lands in spam.
If registration fails, check the email is not already in use and that the verification link has not expired. A new link resolves most cases.
You can leave a review from the product page or the link in your delivery confirmation email. Reviews appear after a short moderation check.
Add a shipping address under Account > Addresses, or enter one at checkout. You can save several and choose a default.
Sign out from the profile menu and sign back in with the other account's credentials. Accounts cannot be merged.
Track your order under Orders in your account. A live tracking link is emailed at dispatch and usually activates within 24 hours.
Refund status appears under Orders > Returns. After we process it, your bank may take a further 3-5 business days to show the credit.
